note: Do not instantiate directly; use itasca.sel.node module functions. 3DEC 7.0-only module: the legacy SEL (structural element) scripting interface. Absent from 3DEC 9.x, where structural elements are accessed through itasca.structure instead. All signatures and descriptions were captured from live 3DEC 7.00 (Release 161) __doc__ introspection.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Get the attachment condition of a node (true = attached to the grid).

methods.name: bond
methods.description: Get the state of the bond between the element node and host rock/ soil (1 = intact, 2 = broken, 3 = none).

methods.name: collection
methods.description: Get the ID number of a node collection from a given node.

methods.name: dis
methods.description: Get the node node dis (vector).

methods.name: dis_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the node node dis.

methods.name: dis_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the node node dis.

methods.name: dis_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the node node dis.

methods.name: extra
methods.description: Get the node extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: fix
methods.description: Get the fixity indicator of the node (false = not fixed (default); true = fixed).

methods.name: force
methods.description: Get the node node forcce (vector).

methods.name: force_app
methods.description: Get the node node applied force (vector).

methods.name: force_app_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the node node applied force.

methods.name: force_app_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the node node applied force.

methods.name: force_app_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the node node applied force.

methods.name: force_shear
methods.description: Get the shear force.

methods.name: force_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the node node forcce.

methods.name: force_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the node node forcce.

methods.name: force_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the node node forcce.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Get the node group name in a given slot.

methods.name: group_remove
methods.signature: node.group_remove(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Remove from the given group from all group slots of the node. One argument of type string, giving the group name, is required. The return value is a bool which is True if the group was removed from any slot, otherwise False.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Get a dictionary describing which groups this node is part of. The keys of the dictionary are the slot names and the values are the group names.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Get the node id.

methods.name: in_group
methods.signature: node.in_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Test if the node is part of a given group. If the optional argument slot is given, only that slot is searched. Otherwise, all group slots are searched.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Get the index (offset) of a node.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Get the length associated with a beam or cable node (half of the average length of connected elements).

methods.name: mass
methods.description: Get the node mass.

methods.name: matnum
methods.description: Get the material number assigned to a node.

methods.name: pos
methods.description: Get the node node position (vector).

methods.name: pos_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the node node position.

methods.name: pos_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the node node position.

methods.name: pos_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the node node position.

methods.name: set_attach
methods.description: Set the attachment condition of a node (true = attached to the grid).

methods.name: set_bond
methods.description: Set the state of the bond between the element node and host rock/ soil (1 = intact, 2 = broken, 3 = none).

methods.name: set_extra
methods.description: Set the node extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: set_fix
methods.description: Set the fixity indicator of the node (false = not fixed (default); true = fixed).

methods.name: set_group
methods.signature: node.set_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> None
methods.description: Set the node group name in a given slot.

methods.name: set_matnum
methods.description: Set the material number assigned to a node.

methods.name: set_vel
methods.description: Set the node node velocity (vector).

methods.name: set_vel_x
methods.description: Set the x-component of the node node velocity.

methods.name: set_vel_y
methods.description: Set the y-component of the node node velocity.

methods.name: set_vel_z
methods.description: Set the z-component of the node node velocity.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Returns True if this node is live.

methods.name: vel
methods.description: Get the node node velocity (vector).

methods.name: vel_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the node node velocity.

methods.name: vel_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the node node velocity.

methods.name: vel_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the node node velocity.
